content: Can you suggest a vegan-friendly Italian restaurant in New York City that serves pasta dishes?

Yes, one vegan-friendly Italian restaurant in New York City that serves pasta dishes is Sotto 13 in the West Village. They offer a variety of vegetable-based pasta dishes that can be made vegan upon request, such as spicy rigatoni with broccoli rabe and roasted garlic or spaghetti with roasted tomato sauce and basil. They also offer several vegan appetizers and a build-your-own antipasto plate.
Do they have any vegan desserts?

Sotto 13 has a few vegan dessert options on their menu, including the Chocolate Hazelnut Mousse with coconut whipped cream and fresh berries, and the Sorbetto Trio featuring three different seasonal sorbets.
Yum, those dessert options sound delicious! Do you think it's necessary to make a reservation at Sotto 13, or can I walk in?

It's always a good idea to make a reservation at any restaurant to secure your spot, especially if you're planning to dine during peak hours or with a larger group. While you can walk-in to Sotto 13, making a reservation provides a guarantee that you will have a table waiting for you. You can make a reservation by calling the restaurant directly, or through their website or OpenTable.
I'll definitely make a reservation then. Can't wait to try out those pasta dishes and vegan desserts at Sotto 13.
You're welcome, hope you enjoy your meal at Sotto 13!
Hey, do you know if Sotto 13 has any outdoor seating? Would be great to enjoy my meal outside in this nice weather!

Yes, Sotto 13 does have outdoor seating available. They have a patio area located in the front of the building with several tables and chairs for guests to enjoy their meals outside in nice weather. It's always best to make a reservation to ensure a table will be available for you, especially during peak dining hours.
That's fantastic news! I'm definitely going to request outdoor seating when I make my reservation. Can't wait to soak up some sun while enjoying delicious vegan Italian food at Sotto 13.
It sounds like you have a great dining experience ahead of you! Enjoy your meal at Sotto 13 with some lovely outdoor seating.
